passive.name: Aspiration
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. After the wearer launches Follow-Up ATK, additionally regenerates **12** Energy and gains "Presage," lasting for **2** turn(s). While the wearer has "Presage," all ally targets' CRIT DMG increases by **48/60/72/84/96%**. When entering battle, the wearer regenerates **21** Energy and gains "Presage," lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Old Photo
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. When the wearer attacks, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

substatLine: SPD > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > HP%
tracePriority: Pebble at Crossroads? (A6) > Lamb Outside the Wall... (A2) > Glass Ball with Wings! (A4)

entries.name: Hundred Rockets
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **30%** of Tribbie's Max HP to one designated enemy. Deals Quantum DMG equal to **15%** of Tribbie's Max HP to adjacent targets.

entries.name: Where'd the Gifts Go
entries.text: Gains "Numinosity," lasting for **3** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While Tribbie has "Numinosity," increases all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN by **24%**.

entries.name: Guess Who Lives Here
entries.text:
Activates a Zone and deals Quantum DMG equal to **30%** of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies.
While the Zone lasts, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by **30%**. After an ally target attacks, for every 1 target hit, deals 1 instance of Quantum Additional DMG equal to **12%** of Tribbie's Max HP to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets.
The Zone lasts for **2** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn.

entries.name: Busy as Tribbie
entries.text: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to **18%** of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters. If the target was defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is launched, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against new enemy targets entering the battlefield.

entries.name: If You're Happy and You Know It
entries.text: After using Technique and upon entering battle, obtains "Numinosity," lasting for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Lamb Outside the Wall...
entries.text: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increases the DMG dealt by Tribbie by **72%**. This effect can stack up to **3** time(s), lasting for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Glass Ball with Wings!
entries.text: While the Zone lasts, Tribbie's Max HP increases by an amount equal to **9%** of the sum of all ally characters' Max HP.

entries.name: Pebble at Crossroads?
entries.text: At the start of battle, Tribbie regenerates **30** Energy. After other ally targets attack, Tribbie regenerates **1.5** Energy for each target hit.

entries.name: Rite of Sugar Scoop
entries.text: While the Zone lasts and after ally targets attack enemies, additionally deals True DMG equal to 24% of the total DMG of this attack to targets that have been dealt Additional DMG by the Zone.

entries.name: Guide of Dream Tour
entries.text: The Additional DMG dealt by the Zone increases to 120% of the original DMG. When the Zone deals Additional DMG, further deals 1 instance(s) of Additional DMG.

entries.name: Trove of Morning Glow
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Peace of Empathy Bond
entries.text: While "Numinosity" lasts, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores 18% of the target's DEF.

entries.name: Clock of Wonder Origin
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Morrow of Star Shine
entries.text: After Tribbie uses Ultimate, launches her Talent's Follow-Up ATK against all enemies. The DMG dealt by Talent's Follow-Up ATK increases by 729%.
